description.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny book. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. Plus an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage.

The target must also make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 6 (2d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

This attack has advantage if the target creature is in the swarm's space.

The Swarm of Possessed, Flaming Books attacks with a flurry of smoky slams and searing swipes. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw.

When the Swarm of Books takes fire damage, it only takes half damage. In addition to this, the swarm becomes engulfed in flames.

While on fire, the Swarm of Books takes 1 fire damage at the end of its turn, and any time it hits a creature with the Paper Cuts attack it deals an additional (3) 1d6 of fire damage.

The swarm will make no attempts to extinguish itself, and will continue to burn until its hit points are reduced to 0 hit points.

The flames can be extinguished by outside sources.

Despite expectation, these old, haunted books are highly resistant to fire and burn slowly.

Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (2d6+4) bludgeoning damage.

The target must also make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 6 (2d6+4) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

This attack has advantage if the target creature is in the swarm's space.

The Swarm of Possessed Books attacks with a flurry of slams and swipes. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw.
